questions.question: Please specify the compound-interest model: the limit (1 + 1/n)^n = e is the final balance for an initial principal of 1 and a 100% annual rate; the interest earned is e − 1. The source gives neither normalisation and calls the limit interest income. Please agree precise wording in both editions.
questions.resolution: Both editions now specify principal 1, a 100% annual rate and n compounding periods: the final balance tends to e and the interest earned to e − 1.

localizations.source: Please specify the compound-interest model: the limit (1 + 1/n)^n = e is the final balance for an initial principal of 1 and a 100% annual rate; the interest earned is e − 1. The source gives neither normalisation and calls the limit interest income. Please agree precise wording in both editions.
localizations.ru: Уточнить финансовую модель: предел (1 + 1/n)^n = e описывает итоговый капитал при начальном капитале 1 и годовой ставке 100%, а сам процентный доход равен e − 1. В источнике нет условий о капитале и ставке, а предел назван доходом. Согласовать точную формулировку для обеих версий.
